activities.activity: Sleeping, with the desk lamp off and the room kept as cool as possible during the overnight heat
Waking up, showering with the water heater, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the university day
Making and eating breakfast: toast from the toaster, fruit from the refrigerator and a cup of tea from the kettle; filling a water bottle for the heatwave
Commuting to Monash University for the day's classes and study sessions
Attending Master of Education lectures, tutorials and seminars on campus
Eating lunch in a shaded campus area and resting out of the 38C heat
Studying in the campus library, reading course material and drafting assignment work on the computer
Commuting home from university during the hottest part of the afternoon
Cooking a simple dinner using the induction cooker and eating it while rehydrating
Sorting laundry and running the washing machine, then hanging clothes to dry
Studying at the desk with the desk lamp on, writing assignment notes on the computer
Relaxing on the sofa with the fan running and watching TV to unwind
Washing up, removing the day's sweat and getting ready for bed
Wind-down time: checking the phone, setting an alarm and preparing clothes for the next day
